name: f1_wrist
status: Complete circuit/layout development; installed F1 and physical tests pending
placement_revision_note: Separate the eight courtyard overlaps found by native DRC. The supply capacitor CDTIA moves upward to preserve its short supply connection.

controller.mount: Two 1x20 2.54 mm female sockets accept a Pico with male headers; the assembly is on the wrist, not on the finger.
controller.power: USB powers the Pico. VBUS supplies the reference; Pico 3V3_OUT supplies analog/digital circuitry. Do not connect another powered 3.3 V source.

connector.mapping: Wrist connector pin n corresponds to fanout connector pin 51-n.
connector.mating_contract: Identical Hirose bottom-contact connectors with the selected Type-A same-side-contact FFC. In the straight inspection pose, board faces are parallel and connector mouths oppose each other. Confirm all conductors with power disconnected.

bias.limits: Source ratios, buffer stability, reference output ESR/derating and complete-array load changes still require checking.

monitor.limits: Coarse electrical monitoring; this does not measure remote row voltages or establish wire-fault coverage.

adc_timing.mode: DIN tied high; CONVST provides 3-wire CS mode
adc_timing.note: Leave CONVST low after a 16-clock read. Before monitor traffic, raise it, discard that extra conversion and keep it high for high-impedance DOUT. Before the next main sample, provide a low interval and a new rising edge.
